name: SecGate 3600 Firewall obj_app_upfile - Arbitrary File Upload
author: SleepingBag945
description: There is an arbitrary file upload vulnerability in the obj_app_upfile interface of Internet SecGate 3600 firewall. An attacker can obtain server permissions by constructing a special request package.
